name: Creeper
description: A hostile mob that explodes when it gets close to a player.

name: Enderman
description: A tall neutral mob that teleports and becomes hostile when stared at.

name: Zombie
description: A common hostile mob that attacks players at close range.

name: Skeleton
description: A hostile mob that attacks players from a distance with a bow.

name: Spider
description: A fast hostile mob that can climb walls.

name: Witch
description: A hostile mob that uses harmful potions against players.

name: Blaze
description: A Nether mob that shoots fireballs and can fly.

name: Slime
description: A bouncing mob that splits into smaller slimes when defeated.
